chapter: Blind Charlie, kin and early memories
title: Uncle Tartone and the Marrero and Frazier cousins
summary: Barnes lists musical relatives: his uncle, the Marrero cousins, the Fraziers, Dave Williams and an aunt who played guitar.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
